title: Quantum Voyage
description: Mattie Carver experiences auditory and visual hallucinations as she witnesses the collapse of space and time.

title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
description: A surgeon (Jason Evers) tapes his fiancée's (Virginia Leith) mouth shut and prepares to put her head on a model's (Adele Lamont) body.

title: Burst City
description: Punk bands protest a nuclear power plant and are attacked by yakuza thugs until a pair of metal-clad bikers arrives.

title: The Final Countdown
description: A time warp takes the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz and its captain (Kirk Douglas) back to Pearl Harbor, Dec. 6, 1941.

title: In the Moscow Slums
description: Moscow, 1902. Konstantin Stanislavsky turns to Vladimir Gilyarovsky to search the underworld for inspiration for a new play. Together they find themselves embroiled in the murder of an Indian Sikh.

title: The Golden Fern
description: A wood cutter finds a golden fern that transforms into a beautiful young woman, but fate conspires to part them.

title: Karmalink
description: In near-future Phnom Penh, Cambodia, a teen boy and a street-smart girl work to untangle the mystery of the boy's dreams of his past life. However, what begins as a playful treasure hunt leads to the possibility of digital enlightenment.

title: Raining in the Mountain
description: A general and an esquire employ martial artists to steal a scroll hidden in the monastery's library.

title: Knock Off
description: Hong Kong business partners (Jean-Claude Van Damme, Rob Schneider) tangle with villains smuggling miniature explosive devices.

title: Along With the Gods: The Last 49 Days

description: Three grim reapers escorts a man to the afterlife and will decide his fate based on what he had done when he was alive.

title: Moon Child

title: Shock Wave 2
description: A bomb disposal officer becomes a suspect in a terrorist attack.

description: A beautiful and seductive witch (Samantha Robinson) concocts spells and potions to make men fall in love with her.
